parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client that contains up to 64 ASCII characters. This ensures that retried requests are idempotent. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the workgroup. It must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description:
The name of the workgroup. The name must meet the following requirements:

- The workgroup name must be unique.

- The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: An array of tags. The array can contain 1 to 20 tags. If the array contains multiple tags, the value of \`Key\` for each tag must be unique.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key. It can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot be an empty string. The key cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value. It can be up to 128 characters in length and can be an empty string. The value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
